stem:
An exponential function has these characteristics:

• The y-intercept is 2.

• The function increases at a rate of 50%.

Which graph best represents this function?

options.label: A
options.text: Graph of a curve that passes near y=1 at x=0 and increases gradually upwards.

options.label: B
options.text: Graph of a curve starting high on y-axis and decreasing rapidly towards x-axis.

options.label: C
options.text: Graph of a curve passing y=2 at x=0 and increasing gradually upwards.

options.label: D
options.text: Graph of a curve starting high on y-axis and decreasing rapidly towards x-axis.

visual_elements: Graphs A, B, C, and D each showing exponential-like curves on coordinate grids with x ranging -4 to 4 and y ranging 0 to 8.
notes: Stem and options preserve wording and math as shown. Graph C shows y-intercept at 2 and an increasing curve, best matching criteria.
